shots.prompt: A single continuous cinematic medium-wide fantasy battle shot, preserving the exact two character designs, costumes, faces, arena, positions, and the blue-orange fire lotus from the input image. Keep both the black-robed young male fighter and the armored enemy readable in frame. Precise timing: 0.0-0.8s, the fighter violently compresses the spinning blue and orange lotus between his hands; flames spiral inward, stones levitate, his robe and hair whip in the pressure wind, while the enemy visibly recoils then raises a golden energy shield. 0.8-1.05s, a tense vacuum micro-pause: fire contracts to a brilliant core, camera makes a short aggressive push-in, the enemy's alarmed expression changes and his stance tightens. 1.05-1.35s, the fighter snaps both palms forward with explosive full-body force; the lotus launches like a hypersonic projectile, strong recoil drives him backward, ground cracks and dust bursts from his feet. 1.35-4.0s, extreme acceleration and speed ramp: camera whip-pans then side-tracks inches behind the lotus, strong foreground parallax and directional motion streaks, the arena races past, the armored target stays visible ahead and grows rapidly larger while actively bracing behind the shield. End just before contact, with the lotus filling the attack line and the target clearly visible. Movement must feel heavy, violent, fast, and decisive, never floating or soft. Faces and character anatomy stay coherent; motion blur affects only fast motion and background. No close-up, no static opponent, no extra people, no cuts, no dissolve, no dialogue. Native sound design: compressed flame roar, rising sub-bass pressure, sudden vacuum hush, hard launch crack, stone debris and fast projectile whoosh.

A single continuous cinematic fantasy attack-impact shot beginning from this exact pre-impact frame. Preserve the exact fire lotus, armored enemy, distant black-robed fighter, character designs, costumes, faces, arena, and attack direction. The target must visibly receive the hit; do not remove him before impact. The impact must be instantaneous, concussive, enormous, and terrifyingly energetic, not a slow decorative flower. No gore, no soft floating motion, no static background characters, no looping, no extra characters, no dissolve, no dialogue. Native sound design: shield crack, one deep concussive blast, pressure-wave thump, layered secondary booms, screaming debris, brief high-frequency ear ring, then heavy rubble and fading fire.
